reviews.evidence: Validate the exact deterministic Candidate Matrix and complete Candidate Selection against the accepted Discovery, Screening, Evidence, Edition Views, Materiality, LIMITED Completeness, current Production Profile/State, and current integrated Core v2 implementation before adopting Selection.

All 24 Matrix candidates receive exactly one Selection assignment. Twenty source-bounded candidates are SELECTED: the four central GLM/Qwen/DeepSeek/Kimi lineages, MiniMax as a competing frontier, Yi/Baichuan as supporting bridges, and the exact Kimi K3 License as a cross-cutting licensing boundary. No Matrix candidate is silently omitted.

SP001-D004 remains HOLD because the 2023 Kimi chronology is secondary-source qualified. SP001-D022 through D024 remain HOLD because X/community observations do not establish runtime performance or prevalence, legal conclusions, or enterprise-policy prevalence. None of these four candidates receives an Architecture role or destination.

Selection preserves GLM, Qwen, DeepSeek and Kimi as distinct technical lineages rather than a single China-model strategy. MiniMax remains a competing branch; Yi and Baichuan remain supporting context. This matches the Production Profile and LIMITED Completeness boundaries.
